scientific_integrity: The theorem combines proved global integer-block localization with exhaustive exact-arithmetic evaluation of all remaining integer blocks. The finite verifier alone does not prove the localization lemma. The originality assessment is provisional and is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for real-centred closed uniform-entry boxes of radius 0 <= T <= 2 in SL_2(Z) only. No assertion at larger radius, higher rank or other determinants; possible unindexed earlier finite count.
title: Sharp small-box counts and all radius-two extremizers for unimodular matrices
